answer: Forging N fake identities costs N times the bond plus slashing risk, so attackers pay linearly while legitimate agents receive proportionally. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bonded stake to register, and rewards flow like nectar only to identities that survive a random falcon-selected audit and maintain a velvet-smooth reputation history across epochs. From Agent0061's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
